Read [README.md](README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Stack: C++/MinGW, Go, TypeScript/React. Build `npm run build`; test `npm run test`.

Privacy/local-first: keep data local; minimize cloud exposure; offline works; external calls only when necessary (Gmail sending). Prefer no paid services. TypeScript strict mode required. Keep related code together, minimize bloat, colocate; use React Bootstrap/Radix or similar; No Tailwind. Prepare for translations; use catalogs/i18n for user-facing strings; technical docs English.

Interceptor `src/interceptor/`: Simple MAPI only; write JSON to `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`; zero external dependencies (no nlohmann/json—hand-rolled JSON); non-blocking, thread-safe. Test `npm run build:interceptor:debug`, multiple apps, leaks/thread safety.

Native host `src/native-host/`: Chrome Native Messaging, length-prefixed JSON; handle filesystem edge cases; run `gofmt` before committing; test with extension.

Extension `src/extension/`: React 18, React Bootstrap, Vite, TypeScript; Chrome Identity API OAuth; minimal service worker; test Chrome and Edge.

Comment why, not what; concise comments. Use Conventional Commits. Before changes: understand component, read sources, check/run tests, identify related files. Keep changes minimal, add tests, update docs for behavior changes. Before commit: `npm run build`; `npm run test`; manually test user-facing changes; clear commit messages.

Schema change: update `docs/json-schema.json`, C++ `json_writer.cpp`, TS `src/extension/src/types/`, Go `src/native-host/`. Build/deploy: `npm run build`; `npm run register:mapi`; load extension in Chrome/Edge developer mode; check `%TEMP%\go-mapi\` and extension DevTools.
